candidate_audits.name: Speka
candidate_audits.notes: [The Grant] Speka provides a recurring $1.00 monthly model usage allowance on its Free plan ($0/mo) that refreshes every month. [The Output] Developers can generate completions, embeddings, and images across all open catalog models with 1 API key and a rate limit of 10 requests per minute (RPM). [The Process] Users sign up with email and password via speka.me/signup without requiring a credit card or upfront payment, and instantly create an API key in the dashboard. [The Condition] Requests are billed against the $1 monthly credit at standard per-token model rates; once the monthly allowance is exhausted, requests return HTTP 402 until the next monthly reset or paid upgrade.
candidate_audits.summary: Speka provides a recurring $1 monthly free model allowance at 10 requests per minute with no credit card required, supporting all open catalog models via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
